maya: Quick update — ran a staged onboard for ZephyrX-embed quantized to int6 on staging-index-7. Observing a localized cluster collapse for our FAQ/KB subset. :thinking:

liam: Can you paste the recall numbers and a short diff vs fp16?

maya: Sure — small snippet from the run:```
model: zephyrx
quant: int6
subset: faq_kb (n=12k)
Recall@1: 0.61 (fp16 baseline 0.72)
Recall@5: 0.86 (fp16 baseline 0.91)
Mean cosine (intra-faq): 0.39 (fp16 0.47)
cluster purity (kmeans k=40): 0.64 (fp16 0.78)
```

julia: Oof, that purity drop is large. Any visual UMAPs?

maya: Pushed a quick UMAP to the artifact bucket: gs://redwood-evals/zephyrx/int6/umap_faq_v1.png — looks like several small dense islands merged into one broad blob.

liam: Hypothesis: quantization is collapsing low-variance directions (entropy anchoring). Did you run per-channel vs per-tensor quant?

maya: Default run was per-tensor symmetric. I have a per-channel job queued next. Also tried folding LayerNorm -> linear in a snapshot, didn't help much.

julia: Try two quick probes: (1) rerun eval with per-channel quant, (2) whiten embeddings (PCA whiten using training set eigenvalues) then measure recall — if whitening improves recall that points to low-dim collapse.

maya: Kicking off both. Command I used:```bash
python eval/run_onboard.py --model zephyrx --quant int6 --quant-mode per_tensor --subset faq_kb --out ./out/int6_pt
python eval/recall.py --pred ./out/int6_pt/embeddings.npy --qk 5 --groundtruth ./data/faq_groundtruth.json
```

eval-bot: job 8791 finished — artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood.ai/8791 (metrics.json, umap.png, embeddings.npy) :white_check_mark:

liam: If per-channel improves things, we might prefer that profile for faq-heavy workloads. But need to test on other cohorts (wiki, support tickets).

maya: Early per-channel numbers (prelim): Recall@1: 0.68, Recall@5: 0.89, mean cosine: 0.44 — much closer to fp16. Still testing noise sensitivity.

julia: Nice. Can you also run a recall stratified by query length and by tf-idf entropy? We want to know if short queries get worse.

maya: Will do. Also adding a probe: quantize only MLP weights vs full-model to see which block drives the collapse.

liam: If MLP-only quant looks fine, maybe we can ship a hybrid profile (MLP int8, attn int6) for cost/quality sweet spot. Worth an A/B in dedicated pool.

maya: Filing a follow-up ticket with artifacts and next steps. Action items: run per-channel full-sweep, whitening ablation, block-level quant ablation, stratified recall (len/entropy).

julia: Thanks — assign to embed-onboard and tag @infra for a dedicated A/B if results stabilize. :eyes:

liam: Optional: run a quick kNN idflip check (k=1) to ensure no label swapping. Use seed 42 to keep results deterministic.

maya: Noted. I'll paste results once per-channel sweep completes.

eval-bot: scheduled follow-up job 8792 (per-channel sweep) — ETA ~45m.
